character.other: A friendly fictional cosmic Quaso avatar with antennae. It suggests neutral wording by default; pronouns can be chosen independently for any avatar. This is an appearance, not a label for nonbinary people.
character.note: Explain that appearance and pronouns are independent choices. All characters are equally welcome.

newspaper.ready: The picnic has elected Quaso mayor. gender is the player-selected way of referring to Quaso. Translate complete sentences; for other use natural neutral paraphrases, for example Spanish la persona en la alcaldía.
newspaper.playing: Live picnic newspaper. count is butter pats collected, from 0 to 12. Each gender case contains its own complete pluralized sentences so agreement and word order can change.
newspaper.won: Successful delivery. count is the number of butter pats delivered. For other, avoid masculine-default titles and pronouns; rephrase the whole sentence naturally.
newspaper.lost: An unsuccessful attempt, with a friendly invitation to try again. count is butter pats collected. No mocking or exclusion based on the selected pronouns.
